touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Wistow qualifies as a local detour through Wistow Maize Maze and Wistow Rural Centre. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Wistow: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Wistow offers Wistow Maize Maze, Wistow Rural Centre, CHURCH OF ST WISTAN within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Wistow Maize Maze
